I never thought it would come to a contest between you and me.
I always knew a time like this would come someday.
You're a man who can't bend his convictions, after all.
I carry the fate of everyone.
I have to see it through.
As one of the royal family, I have burdens of my own to bear.
You've never changed in that respect.
I will give it everything I have.
Do you truly believe you can defeat me?
It is not a question of winning or losing.
I simply mean to give you all my strength.
I see... Your resolve is firm.
Then I'll fight in earnest as well.
So you had something held in reserve.
I know full well how strong you are, Lord Serenoa.
Is she building up her TP?
Let me see what you are truly capable of, young master.
Young master... It's been a long time since anyone called me that.
To me, young master, you will always be the young master.

With the others present,
I thought I would never call you that again...
I never imagined I would have to face you, Benedict.
You have grown into a fine man.
Then why not walk the path I've chosen with me?
Think of me as a wall you must overcome.

The difference in strength is plain.
So the wall must be one of the spirit.
To move forward, there are things one must leave behind.

Understood!
Then I will overcome you!

My apologies!
The enemy has broken through.
No matter. We'll drive them all back.
Well done fighting your way up. I trust you are prepared?
Yes! I'll fight you as my teacher, to learn all I can.
A fine chance to show the prestige of Wolffort. We must win, and build our confidence.
Lord Maxwell, leave clearing the way to me.
Do not underestimate them. I intend to fell them with the first blow.
Splendid. That I should be brought to my knees...
Lord Roland, you have grown strong.
It is all thanks to you, Master.
Strong. No wonder Lord Maxwell acknowledges them.
You cannot call it a victory unless you defeat me. Come, don't hold back.
Yes, I need no telling. I will surpass you, Master!
I won't let us be beaten like this. We'll push them back!
Far from shaken by the disadvantage, they only grow fiercer... As expected of House Wolffort.
This is no training session... Receive my spear!
An eye-opening blow. Not fighting in earnest now would be discourteous.
To be pushed this far... I would hate to think that I, Maxwell, had grown complacent...
Lord Maxwell is being cornered... They are the real thing...
But I will not let you surpass me so easily. On my name as the Spear Saint!
